content.text: The verifier has now twice confirmed the classification, the absence of any non-solicit, and that the outstanding carve-out check is non-probative. There is no substantive defect to fix, and I will not manufacture a deviation to satisfy a heuristic that tests wording for a clause that does not exist. I'll resubmit with a tightened rationale and a more probative quote.

input.quote: c. Limitation on Access. Client will use reasonable commercial efforts consistent with the protection of Client Proprietary Information to restrict access to the Interface to its officers, employees, and agents as may be approved by Client.
input.rationale:
Compliant at the preferred position: the agreement imposes no employee non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant on Mortgage Logic.com, which matches the playbook's preferred outcome ("No non-solicit on Customer"). No redline is proposed.

Basis: (1) Document-wide searches for the rule's detection triggers ("solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "personnel", "recruit", "solicitation", "directly or indirectly") surface no restrictive covenant. The only hits are § 7's unsolicited commercial e-mail (spam) provision and references to "employees" that concern access control (§ 8(c), quoted above) and indemnity beneficiary lists (§ 12) — not hiring or solicitation. (2) Every "shall not" obligation on Client is unrelated: anti-spamming (§ 7), underwriting-decision representations (§ 8(b)), and IP non-infringement warranties (§ 8(e)). (3) § 10 Confidentiality, the other likely location, is confined to Proprietary Information and its exceptions. (4) The "Non-Competition Agreement" referenced in § 8(d) is invoked only as a limit on the credit-data license grant and does not import any personnel restriction into this agreement; that separate instrument should be checked for an employee non-solicit when it is reviewed.

The failed deterministic checks (duration <= 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) test the fallback wording of an existing non-solicit and are non-probative where no such clause exists. Adding a carve-out would require first inserting the very restriction the preferred position rejects, so no edit is warranted. Because the silence favors us, we should not volunteer a mutual non-solicit. If TrueLink raises one, we would hold it to the fallback: personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire. That is recorded as an internal negotiation reserve, not as a point to raise with the counterparty.
